assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
There is a concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of the collapse events
Cardiac event monitoring study is performed with CPT 93271
The cardiac event monitoring study is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The appeal addresses the payer's coverage determination under PR-204
